name: sandbag over the shoulder toss (weighted)
description: Explosively hinge and heave a sandbag backwards over your shoulder. It trains hip power and full body force.
instructions: Stand over the sandbag with feet shoulder width apart.
Hinge down, grip the bag and keep your back flat.
Drive your hips forward and pull the bag up the front of your body.
Extend fully and throw the bag back over your shoulder.
Reset and repeat, facing the same way.
